```{r Algae: Month Differential abundance: Aldex2 + Heatmap}
ps_algae_active <- subset_samples(ps_algae, type == "active")

sample_data(ps_algae_active)$month <- factor(
  sample_data(ps_algae_active)$month, 
  levels = c("March", "April", "May", "June", 
             "July", "August", "September", "October")
)

tax_df <- data.frame(tax_table(ps_algae_active), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Label Function: Strict Genus / Genus+Species Level Only
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
clean_taxon_label <- function(genus, species) {
  if (is.na(genus) || genus == "" || genus == "NA") return(NA_character_)
  
  if (!is.na(species) && species != "" && species != "NA") {
    if (grepl(genus, species, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
      return(species)
    } else {
      return(paste(genus, species))
    }
  }
  return(paste0(genus, " sp."))
}

lowest_rank <- mapply(clean_taxon_label, tax_df$Genus, tax_df$Species)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Subset Phyloseq to Valid Genus/Species ASVs Only
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
valid_asvs <- !is.na(lowest_rank)
ps_algae_genus_level <- prune_taxa(valid_asvs, ps_algae_active)

counts_raw  <- as(otu_table(ps_algae_genus_level), "matrix")
if (!taxa_are_rows(ps_algae_genus_level)) counts_raw <- t(counts_raw)

# Group strictly by valid genus / genus+species labels
valid_labels   <- lowest_rank[valid_asvs]
counts_species <- rowsum(counts_raw, group = valid_labels)

# Keep taxa present in at least 1 sample with >= 5 total reads
keep_taxa           <- rowSums(counts_species > 0) >= 1 & rowSums(counts_species) >= 5
counts_species_filt <- counts_species[keep_taxa, ]

months_vector <- as.character(sample_data(ps_algae_genus_level)$month)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Run ALDEx2 (CLR + Kruskal-Wallis ANOVA)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
set.seed(123)
clr_species <- aldex.clr(
  reads      = counts_species_filt, 
  conds      = months_vector, 
  mc.samples = 128, 
  denom      = "all"
)

kw_species_res <- aldex.kw(clr_species, useMC = TRUE)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Calculate Monthly CLR Means
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
mc_instances <- clr_species@analysisData

clr_means <- sapply(mc_instances, function(sample_mc) {
  rowMeans(sample_mc)
})
rownames(clr_means) <- rownames(counts_species_filt)

target_months <- c("March", "April", "May", "June", "July", "August", "September", "October")

monthly_clr_means <- sapply(target_months, function(m) {
  rowMeans(clr_means[, months_vector == m, drop = FALSE])
})

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Filter Significant Taxa & Build Waterfall Heatmap
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
sig_taxa <- rownames(kw_species_res)[kw_species_res$kw.eBH < 0.05]

if (length(sig_taxa) == 0) {
  warning("No taxa passed kw.eBH < 0.05. Subsetting using unadjusted p-value (kw.ep < 0.05).")
  sig_taxa <- rownames(kw_species_res)[kw_species_res$kw.ep < 0.05]
}

heatmap_matrix_sig <- monthly_clr_means[sig_taxa, , drop = FALSE]

# Row Z-score normalization

  }
}))

heatmap_colors <- colorRampPalette(c("#2166AC", "#F7F7F7", "#B2182B"))(100)
```

# Figure S4: Relative Taxon Abundance: Sampling method
```{r Algae: Class-level Relative Abundance Plot: Sampling Method}
threshold <- 0.01 

# 1. Subset for July and August across BOTH sampling methods (active & passive)
ps_sub <- subset_samples(ps_algae_rarefied, month %in% c("July", "August"))

# 2. Convert counts to relative abundance per sample
ps_rel_algae <- transform_sample_counts(ps_sub, function(x) x / sum(x))

# 3. Agglomerate to Class level
ps_class_algae <- tax_glom(ps_rel_algae, taxrank = "Class", NArm = FALSE)

# 4. Convert phyloseq object to long dataframe
df_long_algae <- psmelt(ps_class_algae)

# 5. Process data at the individual sample level
class_means <- df_long_algae %>%
  mutate(
    Class = case_when(
      is.na(Class) | str_trim(Class) == "" | Class == "NA" ~ "Other",
      TRUE ~ Class
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(Class) %>%
  summarise(mean_abund = mean(Abundance), .groups = "drop")

major_classes <- class_means %>%
  filter(mean_abund >= threshold & Class != "Other") %>%
  pull(Class)

plot_data_algae <- df_long_algae %>%
  mutate(
    Class = case_when(
      is.na(Class) | str_trim(Class) == "" | Class == "NA" ~ "Other",
      TRUE ~ Class
    ),
    Class_collapsed = if_else(Class %in% major_classes, Class, "Other"),
    month = factor(month, levels = c("July", "August")),
    type  = factor(str_to_title(type), levels = c("Active", "Passive"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(Sample, month, type, Class_collapsed) %>%
  summarise(Abundance = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop")

legend_order_algae   <- c("Other", setdiff(unique_classes_algae, "Other"))
```

```{r HAB: Sampling method Stacked Bar}
threshold <- 0.01 

# 1. Subset for July and August across BOTH sampling methods (active & passive)

ps_Genus <- tax_glom(ps_rel_HAB, taxrank = "Genus", NArm = FALSE)

# 4. Convert phyloseq object to long dataframe

# 5. Process data at individual sample level

  mutate(
    Genus = case_when(
      is.na(Genus) | str_trim(Genus) == "" | Genus == "NA" ~ "Other",
      TRUE ~ Genus
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(Genus) %>%
  summarise(mean_abund = mean(Abundance), .groups = "drop")
```
